subject.title: Preview session workspace images and unsupported files

question: Should the session workspace viewer officially support inline previews for AVIF, GIF, JPEG, PNG, and WebP files up to the existing 256 KiB read cap?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but it introduces a new user-facing Gateway, protocol, and Control UI capability on a protected maintainer-labeled PR; product acceptance cannot be inferred from green checks alone.

options.title: Approve bounded image previews
options.body: Land the five-format preview allowlist with metadata-only fallback for all other binary files.

options.title: Keep binary files metadata-only
options.body: Retain strict binary classification but do not return base64 image content through `sessions.files.get`.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded image previews
recommendation.body: Land the five-format preview allowlist with metadata-only fallback for all other binary files.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current workspace-file viewer/editor and explicitly scoped this PR to the remaining binary-preview capability.
